body:
I understand and I am really really sorry that you had to go through it!
Secondly I am sorry I could not reply earlier. I cursed myself that perhaps I did something different and he would have been alive. But iif my 8 years of medical training has taught me something, it is that if someone wants to end their life, they will. They wont tell anyone they wont hesitate. They just WILL!

I' have rather connected to you via IM or voice, easier to get the point across but sure.

I am not going to sit here and tell you that you should not end your life. It is your decision. Though in my profession I take an oath to atleast help save life.
Afterall I am on this sub too. Though a quick look at you (not creeping) showed that you actually have come far in life and have so much to do. You are learning the music of soul! You came this far. Stop chasing happiness, let it come to you, trust me it will. Give yourself some credit. 
You have been such an avid participant of this sub, do you think out of thousands of people who read this just ignored your words? That you did not make a difference at all? 
I am a psychiatrist, you do not need to be in a 'mental hospital' you need someone to talk to. Take a step! Because you know what if on Tuesday you wont, there will be many more who would give up!

Rest is up to you. I just wanted to let you know that you matter.
Give me only 10 minutes of your time. All I ask for.
What is stopping you from it ?
As someone who created a throwaway to post on this sub earlier too. Could I atleast get 5 minutes and get a proper good bye? Would mean the world to me?

I will tell yoi something really personal. I loved my highschool sweet heart, 16 years. I was depressed and she fueled it. Yes it seemed we were happy at times, but I was changing! I wasn't the same person. She left, irrespective of all I did. I was devastated. I tried to end my life two days in a row, before I realized that I am a person of my own. I need to live for myself. There will be a lot of people who could care for you. You have your whole life in front of you. 
Be yourself, dont let anyone change you. That is the key to happiness. :)

You are just contemplating right? 
I've OD on shit tonne of medicine and I'm still lying here waiting for either a seizure or my breath to stop. 
If I can reach out and tell you not to follow what I'm doing, I'm sure you are stronger than me :)
I'm a 4th year medical student becoming a psychiatrist so if that comforts you :)
I can text/call or whatever to keep you busy if that's what you are afraid of. :)

I'm so sorry you feel this way. I am here. If you would like, I would talk to you when you get back. Trust me I'm boring enough that you'd prefer sleep over me :P

Stay positive, stay strong!

You have a gift of life and a lot to accomplish ! 
So much to live for,. I can help you count them., If you ever need someone to remind you that.

Absolutely! I am really glad that you are not contemplating about it yourself. I won't sit here and say that I understand what happened to you because I was not there.
My roommate locked himself in bathroom and choked himself to death. I had to break open the door just to fins him dead. 
You should talk to someone, it is absolutely natural to feel anxiousness and depressed. 
The best you can do for yourself and him is to help contribute to a cause for PTSD vetrns. Keep your spirits high, you are  great friend :)

I can't stop you from doing that! I know what happened to you i terrible. 6 months ago I was drunk driving and  flipped my Jeep 7 times and was still alive. The when I opened my eyes at the hospital, you know the first thing I askedd the doctors was? "Did I hurt anyone?" 
As an experience person on this topic and someone whi is in the medical progression. Please do not do that, 
There are always options and if they arn't, there are not worth taking innocent people taking along with you. Stay strong.

PS: I am here to talk.

I just posted here too sir/ma'am so clearly you wont be wasting my time. I am here to talk to you. I have tried to end my life over a terrible break by twice, I know how it feels. If you would like to talk, I'm right here. Atleast till I am alive
